cohort: 1134 nulliparous women of 50 nationalities in Qatar who had their first antenatal visit at a Primary Healthcare Corporation (PHCC) facility in June 2016-March 2017 and their delivery at a Hamad Medical Corporation facility before 10 November 2017
finding: Adverse pregnancy outcomes were attributable to maternal obesity, with variations in specific outcomes observed between Arab and non-Arab ethnicities.
mod_finding: The study found that overweight Arab women and women with obesity were at increased risk for cesarean section.
